aveMujica.name: 颂乐人偶
aveMujica.desc:
1人数：每刷新6次，获得1名阶级不超过调度中心的随机【颂乐人偶】干员
2人数：<休整期结束时>，每有1名【颂乐人偶】干员，使已激活的盟约层数+2
3人数：【颂乐人偶】干员获得特质“进入休整期时额外获得1资金”
4人数：可部署干员数量上限+1
5人数：【颂乐人偶】盟约的所有效果翻倍

祐天寺若麦/Amoris：【颂乐人偶】干员攻击力提升25%（可随层数叠加，每层增加0.5%）
八幡海铃/Timoris：【颂乐人偶】干员攻击时有25%的概率使敌人停顿1秒（可随层数叠加，每层增加0.1%）
若叶睦/Mortis：【颂乐人偶】干员的攻击附带相当于攻击力25%的凋亡损伤（可随层数叠加，每层增加0.25%）
三角初华/Doloris：【颂乐人偶】干员获得的Fever翻倍
丰川祥子/Oblivionis：没有【颂乐人偶】盟约的干员也能获得【颂乐人偶】盟约25%的效果

tiers.effect: Every 6 shop refreshes: gain 1 random 颂乐人偶 operator of tier ≤ the 调度中心 level.
At 休整期 end, every 颂乐人偶 operator gives +2 layers to every active bond (doubled at 5).
颂乐人偶 operators gain the trait "enter 休整期: +1 fund each" (doubled at 5).
All 颂乐人偶 bond effects are doubled.

spec.caps: Fever cap 450 (battle-shared); Fever state lasts 20 s.
spec.layerGain: Economy-driven like every other core bond.
spec.howToPlay: Collect the 5 颂乐人偶 operators to double everything; 三角初华 doubles Fever gain while 丰川祥子 lets non-member operators share 25% of the member effects.
assumed: Fever = the Ave Mujica team gauge (PRTS 术语释义): every member attack fills it (2 per hit), 三角初华 ×2, 5-person doubles again; at 450 it triggers a 20 s Fever state during which members regenerate SP continuously (approximation of the official "ignore SP and keep casting skills") and no Fever is gained
「使已激活的盟约层数+2」 = every ACTIVE bond (mirroring 蜜莓's official-style trait), including 颂乐人偶 itself
Oblivionis 25% applies to the three member battle effects (Amoris ATK / Timoris slow / Mortis necrosis) for every other on-field operator of the player
「可部署干员数量上限+1」 = deployCap +1 at 4 members (×2 at 5; the player's deploy cap defaults to 8; placement.js enforces it)
